# SundK

SundK is an organization that employs members of [[DANIBD|DANIBD]]'s steering group. At least three individuals—Anne Mette Falstie-Jensen, Jakob Riis, and Mathilde Pedersen—work for SundK as members of the steering group that oversees [[DANIBD|DANIBD]], Denmark's national database for inflammatory bowel disease [^src1].

The organization appears in the documentation of [[DANIBD|DANIBD]] as an institutional affiliation for senior epidemiologists and data administrators involved in the governance and management of the database [^src1].
